entries.subject: DAMIT 311: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-311.txt. Model 311, version 2011-04-21, pole (270°, 19°), period 7.332527 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 118 ±10 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.
